claims.assertion: Mari recounts the Federation account that Orion forces enslaved Lyrians on Phaeton, later Alfrata, until Federation forces liberated it around 1560–1570.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, summarizing the Federation account
claims.qualifiers: She says Federation guidance then introduced a council-based political system.

claims.assertion: Mari reports Urmah objections: they say nearby Avyon would have recorded a Lyra invasion and deny Orion bases in the region.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, reporting Arishah's Urmah perspective
claims.qualifiers: These claims contradict the official Federation narrative.

claims.assertion: Mari suspects the Alfrata story mirrors Earth and promotes belief that the Federation will liberate humanity, discouraging independent action.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
